A Yu-Gi-Oh! deck collection

Twenty decks.
Six reasons to build them.

Every deck in this collection earns its place for a different reason — a summoning method showcased, a playstyle chased, or a childhood archetype finally done right. This is the record of all of it.

Collection report · October 2026

How the twenty decks rank

Every deck scored on one shared scale: consistency, ceiling, floor, both sides of the die roll, resilience, interaction and fit in the current format. Opening-hand odds are calculated exactly from each decklist.

Get the .ydk file

  1. Click . It saves to your Downloads folder as deck.ydk.
  2. Move the file into your simulator's deck folder, or import it from the simulator's deck menu.

Download blocked? Click , paste it into Notepad (on Mac, TextEdit with Format › Make Plain Text), and save it with a name ending in .ydk. In Notepad, set "Save as type" to "All files" so it doesn't save as .txt.

Load it in Dueling Nexus

  1. Click
  2. Open the Dueling Nexus deck editor.
  3. Press Ctrl+V. The deck loads into the editor.
